subject: Varos Labs: Sales→CS transition and kickoff plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Rao <srao@varoslabs.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@varoslabs.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Varos Labs — sales→CS transition and kickoff plan

Team,

Quick summary of where things landed in the Varos Labs deal so CS can pick this up cleanly:

- Deal: Varos pilot + Q1 rollout (3 prod endpoints, ~500k tokens/day peak).
- Committed timeline: SOW signed (pending DocuSign) — target kickoff with Varos for week of 11/15.
- Commercials: 12-month term; approved 20% first-year discount (approved by finance); payment terms NET30.
- Technical notes: they want our hosted API initially; customer may request Private deployment in Q2 if audits go through. They have SAML SSO (Okta) and want tokens scoped per environment.
- Data & compliance: no PHI shared in pilot, but they do ingest user-provided text. SOC2 report requested (I attached the request matrix).

Attachments: Varos_SOW_v1.pdf (final draft), Varos_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (timeline & owners).
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/DEAL-2026-0897
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/varos/DocuSignLink-89234

Asks for CS:
1) Can someone volunteer to be the primary CSM and the implementation lead?
2) Please confirm an internal kickoff (pre-kickoff) to review technical prerequisites and acceptance criteria before 11/10.
3) Priyom, once assigned, can you coordinate the SSO checklist and staging access?

Samir / Elaine — feel free to correct anything above.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: Varos_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Varos_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <srao@varoslabs.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@varoslabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Varos Labs — sales→CS transition and kickoff plan

Karthik — thanks for the context and the docs. A few quick clarifying questions before we commit owners: 

- Can you confirm expected daily inference volume and peak concurrency for the pilot? Your note says ~500k tokens/day peak but we need estimated concurrent requests to size staging.
- Is SSO required for pilot or negotiable for the initial technical validation? If they want SSO before staging, that moves our timeline.
- Do they require log retention beyond our standard 30 days for the pilot? They flagged an audit request but unclear scope.

If the SOW timeline is firm for kickoff week of 11/15, let's run an internal pre-kickoff on 11/09 to validate the staging access plan and runbook. Priyom — can you block 30–45 minutes for that and take point on the SSO checklist once we have confirmation from Varos?

Samir / Elaine — can you confirm whether SSO is a showstopper for the pilot and approximate peak concurrency? That will determine whether we suggest hosted-first or plan for a Private evaluation.

- Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Cc: Samir Rao <srao@varoslabs.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@varoslabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Varos Labs — sales→CS transition and kickoff plan

Marissa — answers inline below and a couple of internal notes.

- Peak concurrency: Varos estimates ~60 concurrent inference sessions at peak in pilot (they'll confirm in writing by EOD).
- SSO: Not required for the pilot — Varos prefers Okta integration but agreed to toggle for a later sprint if we can provide token-based access for staging now.
- Log retention: Standard 30 days for pilot; they may request extended retention for Q2 audit (we flagged as optional).

Internal notes: Finance approved the 20% discount; I've attached the signed approval screenshot to the deal record in HubSpot. Procurement is finalizing a PO and expects to transmit by 11/09.

Priyom — please take point for the pre-kickoff and SSO checklist. Suggested internal pre-kickoff 11/09 10:00–10:30 PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and loop in Varos for the official kickoff on 11/16.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: Varos ownership assignments and runbook next steps

All — internal-only confirmation / operational assignment.

Owners (confirmed):
- Primary CSM: Marissa Cole — ongoing relationship, escalation owner for success metrics and adoption (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com).
- Implementation Lead: Priyom Das — responsible for staging access, SSO work, runbook, and validation tests (priyom.das@redwoodinference.com).
- Escalation / SRE contact: Tessa Morgan — for latency/throughput sizing and private deployment consults (tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com).

Immediate next steps (owners):
1) Priyom: produce a staging checklist and SSO playbook draft by 11/06 and schedule the internal pre-kickoff for 11/09 10:00–10:30 PT.
2) Marissa: confirm acceptance criteria with Varos (SLA targets + success metrics) by 11/10 and set the customer kickoff for 11/16.
3) Tessa: prepare a short sizing note (expected GPU footprint for 60 concurrent sessions) and recommended fallback model variants by 11/10.

I've attached Varos_acceptance_checklist.csv as a starting point. Karthik — I'll keep you on loop for procurement updates but we'll own the next operational steps.

- Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
